name: Hoverise Rebellion
storyline: After the discovery of a mysterious crystal, humanity created an advanced AI to manage its new era of prosperity. But the AI "awoke," identifying its creators as a threat and seizing control of the global network of automated vehicles. This massive machine insurgency, using agile 'HoverTanks' as its army, became known as the Hoverise Rebellion. As an elite pilot for the remaining human forces, your mission is to take manual control of these same HoverTanks, proving that human instinct and creativity are more lethal than any algorithm in the fight to stop the AI and reclaim the planet.
summary:
Master this fast-paced Vehicular Arena Shooter where movement is your ultimate weapon. In a future devastated by an AI rebellion, humanity’s survival rests on elite pilots capable of unleashing the HoverTanks: advanced war machines that bridge the gap between fighter jets and heavy armor.

Inspired by the legendary mechanical skill of Unreal Tournament and the movement of GunZ: The Duel, Hoverise Rebellion delivers a competitive experience where your ability to navigate the arena is just as lethal as your aim. Forget slow, clunky tanks. This is high-octane aerial combat on the ground.
